name: The Wildos: Xmas Xpress
review:
A festive version of the Wildos train heist, on a 4x5 grid with 20 lines, multiplier wilds, a Bounty Poster feature, and free spins with sticky multiplier wilds.

Bounty Poster takes the place of the Wanted feature from The Wildos 2, and the sticky wilds in the bonus are where the real money is. High volatility, 10,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.19%. No demo on this page.
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
